# Rushing yards + qb rushing yards tuning (rushnorm): tune seasons only

*Generated by `backtest.py --tune-width --tune-grid rushnorm --tune 2022,2023`. Do not edit by hand. This run read the tune seasons only.*

How the eligible players' carry shares are rescaled toward 1 - rush_other_share, with or without the starting QB (rush_norm_qb). *Off* = no rescaling: the 'other' bucket is whatever the shares leave (the sampler before props-v1.23). **Disclosed (DECISIONS #103):** two design variants were run on 2024-25 before the QB choice was put into this grid; the result did not beat the live model there and was not shipped. Every other setting is held at the shipped values (`{"catch_conc": null, "eff_sd_qb": 0.15, "eff_sd_rec": 0.0, "eff_sd_rush": 0.3, "share_conc_carries": 20.0, "share_conc_qb": 80.0, "share_conc_targets": 40.0}`). Rule: CRPS summed over rushing yards + QB rushing yards (each relative to the family off) first; among settings not measurably worse than the best, the actual/model mean closest to 1.00.
